findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 47 requests to 4 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).
Of 3.8 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 534 kB (14%) came from third-party domains, 14 kB of it from services classified as tracking (2 requests).
